items.title: Method and apparatus for crystal drift compensation

focus.zh: Fig.4：mod-8、RV 高低位、CKVD8 与 SEL_EDGE（核心在 Fig.4，而非仅看标题）。
focus.en: Fig. 4: mod-8, RV high/low bits, CKVD8 and SEL_EDGE (the core is Fig. 4, not the title).

role.zh: CKV 驱动 mod-8 低位 RV<2:0>、CKVD8 驱动高位 RV<8:3>，CKV 上升/下降沿各采一套 FREF 候选，SEL_EDGE 参与选择。直接证明少量高速低位状态与降频高位可以组成 VPA，且 fine-side 边沿判定可参与 coarse 路径选择。
role.en: CKV clocks the mod-8 low bits RV<2:0>, CKVD8 clocks the high bits RV<8:3>; FREF is sampled into two candidate sets on CKV rising and falling edges and SEL_EDGE takes part in selection. Directly proves that a few fast low-bit states plus slower high bits can form a VPA, and that a fine-side edge decision can steer coarse path selection.

limits.zh: 不能解释为“先把 fine TDC 输入统一变为 8T0，再由 snapshot 自动压缩成 T0”，也不直接披露本项目的 P/S 绝对边沿执行器；高位极性与流水原点应以 Fig.4 逐路径核对，不能机械拼接。
limits.en: Cannot be read as 'first make every fine TDC input 8T0, then let the snapshot compress it back to T0', and it does not directly disclose this project's P/S absolute-edge executor; high-bit polarity and pipeline origin must be checked path by path in Fig. 4, not stitched mechanically.

items.title: Phase accumulator for digital phase locked loop

focus.zh: Fig.6–7：高六位 /4、shift state、采样后 encoder。
focus.en: Fig. 6–7: six high bits at /4, shift state, encoder after sampling.

role.zh: 低速高六位 modulo incrementer 加高速移位状态；低位信息在 CKR 采样后由 4-to-2 encoder 恢复，某些实施方式还用高计数器最低位参与解码。说明“原周期 residue 必须保留”不等于“一定用高速二进制低位加法器”：高速侧可保存易实现的状态，慢速侧再解码。
role.en: A slow six-bit modulo incrementer plus a fast shift state; the low-bit information is recovered after CKR sampling by a 4-to-2 encoder, and some embodiments also use the LSB of the high counter in decoding. Shows that 'the raw-cycle residue must be kept' does not mean 'a fast binary low-bit adder is required': the fast side can store an easy state that the slow side decodes.

limits.zh: 状态编码并不免除 epoch 一致性；不能单独证明同一低位状态已经控制 short-TDC 的物理选沿，也不能把所有 encoder 输入假定为独立同步的普通总线。
limits.en: State encoding does not waive epoch consistency; it cannot alone prove that the same low-bit state already controls short-TDC physical edge selection, nor can all encoder inputs be assumed to be an ordinary independently synchronised bus.

selection.zh: 未证明目标 short TDC 连接
selection.en: Connection to the target short TDC not shown

missing.zh: 低位到物理选沿的直接映射
missing.en: Direct mapping from low bits to physical edge selection

items.title: High speed counter apparatus

focus.zh: 低两位、CKVD4、11→00 carry 与组合计数。
focus.en: Two low bits, CKVD4, the 11→00 carry and the combined count.

role.zh: 低两位状态形成与 carry 相关的 CKVD4 并由其驱动高位，组合得到连续的 8-bit 计数。可用于核对式 (1)–(2) 要求的 count lineage：慢计数不能只是任意同频 /4 时钟驱动，必须与低位 wrap 在逻辑上关联。
role.en: The two low bits form the carry-related CKVD4 that drives the high bits, giving a continuous 8-bit count. Useful for checking the count lineage required by Eqs. (1)–(2): the slow count cannot be driven by just any /4 clock of the same frequency; it must be logically tied to the low-bit wrap.

limits.zh: 连续计数成立，不等于参考相关 snapshot 已经安全；也不是共享 short-TDC、selected-edge 和完整相位重建的证明。
limits.en: A continuous count does not mean the reference-related snapshot is safe; nor is it proof of a shared short TDC, selected edge or complete phase reconstruction.

check.zh: 11→00、CKVD4 有效沿、高位 carry 的对应

short.zh: CN105071798 · 延迟匹配相位累加器

items.title: 应用于全数字PLL的低功耗相位累加器 (Low-power phase accumulator for an all-digital PLL)

focus.zh: Fig.4–6：CKR 分级延迟、各组采样与最终重采样。
focus.en: Fig. 4–6: staged CKR delays, per-group sampling and final resampling.

role.zh: 以异步低位和同步高位降低计数功耗，把 CKR 采样时刻按各级传播延迟展开，再统一重采样输出；针对“各位并非同时稳定”。说明相干快照的本质是同一逻辑 epoch，而不是所有寄存器使用零偏差时钟。
role.en: Asynchronous low bits and synchronous high bits reduce counting power; the CKR sampling instants are spread according to each stage's propagation delay and then resampled together — addressing 'bits do not settle at the same time'. Shows that a coherent snapshot means one logical epoch, not zero-skew clocks on every register.

limits.zh: 最终统一输出并不自动证明中间每一级的 setup/hold 满足；必须同时校验数据和采样路径的 min/max 延迟、同源误差与 PVT 差异，延迟链不能被当作理想常数。
limits.en: The final common output does not automatically prove that setup/hold is met at every intermediate stage; min/max delays of data and sampling paths, common-source errors and PVT differences must be checked together — the delay chain is not an ideal constant.

missing.zh: 选沿、残差与有效性联动
missing.en: Linking edge selection, residual and validity

check.zh: 数据传播、CKR 各级延迟、最终统一输出
check.en: Data propagation, per-stage CKR delays, final common output

short.zh: Kuo 2018 · 八相选相 + 短 TDC

items.title: An All-Digital PLL for Cellular Mobile Phones in 28-nm CMOS With −55 dBc Fractional and −91 dBc Reference Spurs
items.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I, 65(11), pp. 3756–3768; DOI 10.1109/TCSI.2018.2855972

focus.zh: Fig.2、5–6：DCO/CKV 节点、八相与短 TDC，及实验部分的调谐范围。
focus.en: Fig. 2, 5–6: DCO/CKV nodes, eight phases and short TDC, plus the tuning range in the experimental section.

role.zh: DCO 的 /4 输出构成八相 CKV，配合预测选相、短 TDC 和多候选参考重定时；Octal 信息与 fine TDC 配合，variable phase 另有整数采样路径。是“物理选相 + 局部 fine 测量”的直接实现。
role.en: The DCO's /4 output forms an eight-phase CKV, combined with predictive phase selection, a short TDC and multi-candidate reference retiming; octal information works with the fine TDC while the variable phase has its own integer sampling path. A direct implementation of 'physical phase selection + local fine measurement'.

limits.zh: DCO 调谐范围 5.7–8.4 GHz，/4 后为 1.425–2.1 GHz，“约 2 GHz”不能误写成“原始 DCO 约 2 GHz 再 /4”；T_V/8 换算到 T0 是 T0/2 而非 T0/8。它是周期内多相选择，不能未经映射等同 raw-CKV 的 3-bit /8 integer residue 或 whole-cycle slot executor；其 time-predictive 选相属于先验规划，不是参考到来后任意慢速算完再选过去的相位。
limits.en: DCO tuning range 5.7–8.4 GHz, i.e. 1.425–2.1 GHz after /4 — '≈2 GHz' must not be misread as 'a raw ≈2 GHz DCO then /4'; T_V/8 converted to T0 is T0/2, not T0/8. It is intra-period multiphase selection and cannot, without mapping, be equated with a 3-bit /8 raw-CKV integer residue or a whole-cycle slot executor; its time-predictive selection is a priori planning, not 'compute slowly after the reference and pick a phase that already passed'.

consistency.zh: 多候选重定时、区域处理

selection.en: Predictive phase selection and short TDC

missing.zh: raw integer residue 的直接复用
missing.en: Direct reuse of a raw integer residue

check.en: Multirate structure, variable phase, CKR candidates and predictive selection

check.zh: /4 八相、并行短 TDC 到共享短 TDC 的关系
check.en: /4 eight phases; relation from parallel short TDCs to a shared short TDC

short.zh: Sony · 共享状态与两个 XOR 修正
short.en: Sony · shared state & two XOR corrections

items.title: Phase locked loop, electronic device, and method for controlling phase locked loop
items.authors: T. Kurihara, T. Fujiwara (Sony Semiconductor Solutions)

note.zh: “2022 年公开”只适用于所列美国公布文本，不是整个家族最早公开时间。
note.en: 'Published 2022' applies only to the listed US publication, not to the earliest publication of the whole family.

focus.zh: Fig.6、8、11、12：CNTO、VINT、VFRAC、CRRCT/SIGN。
focus.en: Fig. 6, 8, 11, 12: CNTO, VINT, VFRAC, CRRCT/SIGN.

role.zh: CNTO[0] 与慢 accumulator 高位形成整数码，CNTO[3:0] 又由 REFCLK 直接采为 VFRAC；据两条路径的状态差异生成 CRRCT 与 SIGN（式 9）并给出 0/−1/+1 修正。应定位为另一条明确、紧凑的共享状态与修正实现，而不是最早先例（Havens 更早）。
role.en: CNTO[0] with the slow accumulator's high bits forms the integer code, while CNTO[3:0] is sampled directly by REFCLK as VFRAC; the state difference of the two paths yields CRRCT and SIGN (Eq. 9) and a 0/−1/+1 correction. To be positioned as another explicit, compact shared-state-and-correction implementation — not the earliest precedent (Havens is earlier).

limits.zh: 用多相 latch/correction 替代传统 TDC，不能说已接上本项目 short TDC；VFRAC 是带周期冗余的状态码（Fig.12 值跨至 1.75），修正量的“1”须按原相位单位解释；不能从式 (9) 推出对任意异步错误都保证唯一复原，个别 retiming 节点/位序需结合 Fig.6、8、11、12 交叉确认。
limits.en: It replaces a conventional TDC with multiphase latch/correction, so it is not connected to this project's short TDC; VFRAC is a state code with cycle redundancy (Fig. 12 values reach 1.75), and the '1' of the correction must be read in its original phase unit; Eq. (9) does not guarantee unique recovery from arbitrary asynchronous errors, and some retiming nodes/bit orders must be cross-checked in Fig. 6, 8, 11, 12.

split.en: CNTO serves both integer and fractional

selection.zh: 多相 latch；非目标短 TDC
selection.en: Multiphase latch; not the target short TDC

check.zh: 同一 CNTO 到 integer 与 fractional 的两条路径
check.en: The two paths from one CNTO to integer and fractional

check.zh: XOR、位序、扩展 VFRAC 状态、修正方向
check.en: XORs, bit order, extended VFRAC states, correction direction

short.zh: Havens · 共享状态与 sub-fractional TDC

items.title: Digital phase locked loop

focus.zh: Fig.2–4：integer / fractional / sub-fractional、half-rate state、even/odd 与 one-count uncertainty。
focus.en: Fig. 2–4: integer / fractional / sub-fractional, half-rate state, even/odd and one-count uncertainty.

role.zh: 反馈计数器同时包含 integer、fractional 和 sub-fractional TDC；整数值由 cnt[7:1] 与分频状态 ckh[0] 组成，多相半速状态被采样用于 fractional detector 并保留 even/odd 信息，以处理同步器的 one-count uncertainty。说明共享状态、整数边界校验和更细的 TDC 测量并非直到 Sony 才出现，也说明冗余状态的覆盖范围必须与可能的 epoch 错误匹配。
role.en: The feedback counter contains integer, fractional and sub-fractional TDC parts; the integer value is cnt[7:1] plus the divider state ckh[0], and multiphase half-rate state is sampled for the fractional detector, keeping even/odd information to handle the synchroniser's one-count uncertainty. Shows that shared state, integer-boundary checking and finer TDC measurement existed before Sony, and that the coverage of redundant state must match the possible epoch errors.

limits.zh: half-rate / parity 结构不能直接替代 /8 block-epoch 检查；其 sub-fractional 实现也不是未经修改就等同 Kuo 的预测选相后单个 short TDC。
limits.en: The half-rate / parity structure cannot directly replace a /8 block-epoch check; its sub-fractional implementation is not, unmodified, the same as Kuo's single short TDC after predictive selection.

split.en: Half-rate state doubles as integer LSB

missing.zh: /8 block epoch 与目标执行器
missing.en: /8 block epoch and the target executor

check.zh: ckh、cnt 高位、raw state、even/odd 与 sub-fractional 处理
check.en: ckh, cnt high bits, raw state, even/odd and sub-fractional handling

short.zh: MediaTek · PHF2 选相坐标补偿

items.title: Frequency synthesizer and associated method
items.authors: A.-S. Lin, R. B. Staszewski, Y.-H. Cho (MediaTek)

focus.zh: PHV / PHF1 / PHF2、phase shifter、phase selector 及单脉冲实施例。
focus.en: PHV / PHF1 / PHF2, phase shifter, phase selector and the single-pulse embodiment.

role.zh: raw-CKV VPA 与 shifted CKV′ 的 TDC 路径共存，用附加的 PHF2 补偿选相坐标，原文给出 PHE = PHR + PHF1 + PHF2 − PHV。支持“保留原 CNT，同时显式补偿 selected edge offset”。
role.en: A raw-CKV VPA coexists with the TDC path of a shifted CKV′, and an extra PHF2 compensates the selected-phase coordinate; the patent gives PHE = PHR + PHF1 + PHF2 − PHV. Supports 'keep the original CNT while explicitly compensating the selected-edge offset'.

limits.zh: whole-cycle absolute-edge executor 是本项目的进一步综合，不是该公式自动完成的功能。
limits.en: A whole-cycle absolute-edge executor is this project's further synthesis, not something the formula accomplishes automatically.

check.en: Coordinates of the selected CKV′, PHF2 and the TDC

short.zh: Marvell · 独立边界估计与整周期修正

items.title: Methods and devices for implementing all-digital phase locked loop

focus.zh: RF-counter/TDC skew、独立 estimator E、Fig.20–25 附近实施例。
focus.en: RF-counter/TDC skew, independent estimator E, embodiments around Fig. 20–25.

role.zh: 使用 RF counter/TDC skew correction 及独立的边界估计信息，判断 fractional code 应接近 0 还是 1，从而修正整周期错配。提示不能让 fine code 同时承担全部的范围、边界和自我可信性判断。
role.en: Uses RF counter/TDC skew correction plus independent boundary-estimate information to decide whether the fractional code should be near 0 or 1, thereby correcting whole-cycle mismatch. A reminder not to let the fine code carry all range, boundary and self-trust decisions by itself.

limits.zh: 估计器自身的模糊区域同样要约束；对本目标仍缺少 /4–/8 高低位执行集成。
limits.en: The estimator's own ambiguous region must also be bounded; /4–/8 high/low-bit execution integration is still missing for this target.

check.zh: RF count / fractional skew 与独立边界估计
check.en: RF count / fractional skew and the independent boundary estimate

items.title: A Low-Noise Fractional-N Digital Frequency Synthesizer With Implicit Frequency Tripling for mm-Wave Applications
items.authors: Z. Zong, P. Chen, R. B. Staszewski

focus.zh: Fig.1、9–10：CKV 节点、2+6 counter、CKS sampling、DTC/TDC。
focus.en: Fig. 1, 9–10: CKV node, 2+6 counter, CKS sampling, DTC/TDC.

role.zh: 8-bit PHV_I 使用两位异步低位和六位同步高位；Fig.9 的 CKS_0/1/2 沿采样链匹配计数传播，匹配条件下采样位于计数位稳定后约半个 CKV 周期；系统采用 DTC-assisted TDC，检测溢出/下溢并在瞬态采用限幅输出。这是 split counter、明确采样时序和有限 TDC 在同一 ADPLL 内共存的直接论文证据。
role.en: The 8-bit PHV_I uses two asynchronous low bits and six synchronous high bits; in Fig. 9 the CKS_0/1/2 sampling chain matches count propagation, placing the sample about half a CKV period after the count bits settle; the system uses a DTC-assisted TDC that detects overflow/underflow and clamps its output during transients. Direct paper evidence of a split counter, explicit sampling timing and a finite TDC coexisting in one ADPLL.

limits.zh: Fig.1 的 CKV 已是约 20 GHz 基波经 /8（/4 与 /2）后的节点，不能把 Fig.9 的低两位等同于“20 GHz 基波全部周期的低两位”；其饱和限幅策略也不能等同于“饱和仍是精确 fine”或本项目已经验证的 coarse-only fallback。
limits.en: The CKV of Fig. 1 is already the ≈20 GHz fundamental after /8 (/4 then /2), so Fig. 9's two low bits are not 'the low bits of every 20 GHz fundamental cycle'; its saturation-clamp strategy is neither 'saturation is still exact fine' nor this project's verified coarse-only fallback.
